key.name: badge-position
key.summary: Badge corner on each taskbar app icon
key.description: Which corner of the app icon the window-count badge is drawn in. The default, bottom-right, sits opposite the top-right notification counters so the two never overlap.

key.name: count-threshold
key.summary: Minimum window count required to show the badge
key.description: The badge is shown only when an application has at least this many windows on the counted workspace(s). The default of 2 hides the badge for single-window applications; set it to 1 to always show the count.

key.name: count-all-workspaces
key.description: When false (the default) the badge counts only the application's windows on the current workspace. When true it counts every window of the application across all workspaces.

key.name: badge-text-color
key.description: Any CSS color accepted by GNOME Shell (e.g. '#ffffff', 'white', 'rgba(255,255,255,0.9)'). Applied live; no Shell reload is required.

key.name: badge-background-color
key.description: Any CSS color accepted by GNOME Shell. The default 'transparent' keeps only the numeral visible over the icon. Applied live.

key.name: badge-font-size
key.description: Font size of the badge numeral in pixels. Applied live.
